fieldNotes.facility: Flint Truck Assembly (Flint Assembly), 3100 Van Slyke Rd, Flint MI. GM's oldest operating assembly plant (since 1947), ~5.2M sq ft of building on a fenced ~159-acre core plant parcel that sits inside a larger multi-parcel campus of ~300+ acres counting the finished-vehicle lots, rail yard, and south logistics/cross-dock yard. Builds Chevrolet Silverado HD and GMC Sierra HD heavy-duty pickups (sole source for dually HD). Geocode at the roof centroid; confirmed against Wikipedia coordinate 42.9851,-83.7169 and Street View of the brick administration building on Van Slyke Rd reading 'Flint Assembly'.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Entire campus is fenced (chain-link perimeter clearly visible in Street View at the Van Slyke admin building, with gated openings in the fence line). Controlled truck access: a fenced south logistics yard off the access road (Street View pano xXgQ6Z3bfvjk8mIdFwhHHg shows XTRA and other trailers parked behind perimeter chain-link), plus plant truck gates on the west/rail side and the south Bristol-side access. Multiple controlled entrances - truckGateCount estimated at 3 and marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: GM assembly plants of this scale run staffed security gatehouses at controlled truck entrances. A clean overhead isolation of the individual booth structure was not possible at this resolution (residential streets along Van Slyke prevent a tight Street View of the truck lanes), so guardShack is marked uncertain but assessed true given fenced perimeter + multiple controlled gates.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer perimeter truck gate plus internal vehicle-control checkpoints between the plant, finished-vehicle marshalling lots, and the south logistics yard - typical multi-stage flow for an integrated assembly campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: Active rail corridor and internal rail yard run the full length of the west boundary parallel to I-475, with auto-rack and box-car spurs serving the plant; finished-vehicle rail-load lots on the north end.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer storage confirmed in two areas: (1) the south logistics/cross-dock yard off the access road - dozens of trailers in organized rows alongside a large white cross-dock building, plus outdoor steel/frame material storage; (2) trailer rows along the west buildings near the rail yard. Separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible across the south logistics yard rows and west-side trailer lines; capacity easily 150-200.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~45 loading doors across the south cross-dock building faces and the multiple dock aprons on the main plant - estimate from overhead imagery, marked uncertain given the dense 1947-era roofline obscures some bays.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts/material cross-dock and trailer staging run from the dedicated south logistics yard, while finished-vehicle shipping marshals from the north rail-load and vehicle lots - physically separate clusters on different ends of the campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane internal access roads and a large gate apron at the south logistics entrance with unused paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large building clusters on one campus - the original main assembly building (dark 1947 roofline), the 2016 paint shop, the south cross-dock/logistics building, and ancillary structures - a campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Flint metro fabric, hard against I-475 with dense residential subdivisions immediately east across Van Slyke Rd and commercial development to the south on Bristol Rd - Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in the imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound at the main logistics gate; not crisply countable from overhead - uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least 3 controlled truck entrances inferred (south logistics, west/rail plant gate, Bristol/south access); exact count uncertain.
